description: To answer a traveller, use find_trips first: it searches every trip on the site by place, name, number or link and returns dated prices. Find Sparkling Tracks packages that visit a given city or country, named in English or in any of our languages. Optional date_from/date_to (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) filter by the real departure calendar: with a city query, only packages whose stay in that city overlaps the range are returned, each annotated with city_date_windows giving the departure, arrive and leave dates and the tour day; with a country query, only packages that fit entirely inside the range. Returned package summaries are translated to the requested language; currency follows the currency param. Every response carries price_basis, which states the exactness of every price field it returns (these are "from" prices, never per-date quotes) and the booking path.

currency.description: Currency for the price_localized fields. Conversion is approximate, EUR-based; the binding price at booking is always EUR. Default: EUR. A value outside the list is refused.

date_from.description: Start of the travel date range (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). A date before today is read as today. When the destination/query names a city on a package route, only packages whose stay in that city overlaps [date_from, date_to] are returned, each annotated with city_date_windows (departure, arrive, leave, tour day). Otherwise only packages that fit entirely inside the range are returned. date_from alone with a city means "in that city on exactly this day"; alone without a city it means "departing on or after this date".

date_to.description: End of the travel date range (ISO YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be on or after date_from. When omitted: with a city query and date_from it defaults to date_from (a single day); without a city the range is open-ended.

language.description: Output language for translatable fields (city names, country names, trip titles, descriptions). Default: en. zh is Simplified Chinese. A value outside the list is refused.

query.description: City or country name, in English or in any of our languages (e.g. "Lisbon", "Switzerland", "Czech", "Wien"). Letter case and accents do not matter. A name we know is read as its English name, which is repeated under asked.
